verdict.rationale: Adaptive streaming quality and user-set resolution and frame rate are fair questions for a remote-desktop product like AnyDesk, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of bandwidth-adaptive quality or of manual resolution or frame-rate controls. The CLI and REST API items cover installation, connections and session data only, and the community items on launch benchmarks and missing stats do not describe these settings.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
